description: Pro. Audit head metadata across a site. Crawls the site from `url` (same origin only, up to 40 pages, 4 requests at a time, or only the `paths` you list), uses sitemap.xml to find pages, and obeys robots.txt for the user agent ATPDesigners. Reads static HTML only. The result opens with coverage: pages read of pages found, which were skipped or truncated, and requests used. Checks title and description presence, length and duplicates, canonical links that point elsewhere, html lang, viewport, og and twitter tags, robots meta noindex, hreflang validity and icon links.

maxPages.description: Optional lower page cap. The hard cap is 40 pages.

paths.description: Optional list of same-origin paths such as /about. When given, only these pages are read and links are not followed.

sitemap.description: Use sitemap.xml to find pages. Default true.

url.description: Home page or any page on the site. The crawl stays on this origin.

name: site_meta_audit
title: Site meta audit
